title: Segmented choice
responsibility: Offers a labeled group of string-valued choices.

inputs.name: SegmentedChoice.value
inputs.description: Optional bindable selected string; it defaults to the empty string and controls each option's active class and aria-pressed value. Clicking an option assigns that string; when it matches no option, every button is unselected.

inputs.name: SegmentedChoice.options
inputs.description: Required strings rendered in array order as both button text and keyed each-block identities. The keys therefore need to be unique; an empty array renders no buttons.

inputs.name: SegmentedChoice.label
inputs.description: Required string used as the group's aria-label.

outputs.name: SegmentedChoice
outputs.description: Renders an hx-div with role="group" and aria-label from label, with one hx-button type="button" for each option. Each button displays its option and has active class and aria-pressed set when its option equals value; clicking it assigns that option to value.
